data.text:
Sheesh - how many walls are there between the basement wall and the kitchen wall.

- Basement has one stud space between laundry and bathroom
- The next stud space maps to the first wall in the main floor bathroom. It contains the toilet drain going to the 2nd floor
- But look behind the bathtub and you can see _two_ additional stud spaces then the back of drywall, furthest back not quite aligned with the rest
- But measure from the basement bathroom and that doesn’t line up with the tiled wall void space - that’s essentially a 5th stud space, intruding somewhat into the 4th

There’s a full 16.5 inches counting the basement wall stud space to the stud space associated with the tiled void. 3.5 x 4 = 14, 3.5 x 5 = 17.5. So 4 full studspaces plus change for drywall layers

Can see some of the depth from the pix we took of the bathroom reno. While most the walls were normal there was a 3 studspace deep cavity behind the bathtub, visible [here](https://photos.google.com/share/AF1QipPevDTrlrVfhy2fZ7Cl-7n85mdhYtrYjCkm8Llj5ba1iRNKv1HvivO9SO4cFSeWeA/photo/AF1QipMQx-wShMxpS1JPjiYG5hmbvddH-RCmsJKTecKu?key=WTJ2OTY0OFRHcTN6NlZmNE04WTdlSWhBd2JWQW5B "‌"). Add that to the 4th studspace in the basement and there are the 4 layers. But then what’s with the 5th, in the tiled voidspace? Ending 16.5 inches from the basement wall that seems deeper than 4 studspaces.
